name: Interpolation Degree / Shattering-Cover Projection VC Dimension
details: The draft conjecture $\mathrm{intdeg}(\mathcal H)=\mathrm{SCVC}(\mathcal H)$ is false. On $\mathcal C_{\mathrm{int}}=\{001,010,011,100\}$, the two quantities are respectively $1$ and $2$. The reverse one-sided comparison is separately refuted by $\mathcal C_{\mathrm{rev}}$.
proof: The constant polynomial and the three coordinate functions have linearly independent evaluation vectors on the four concepts, so $\mathrm{intdeg}(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{int}})=1$. The projection to $\{x_2,x_3\}$ is the full two-cube, so it is admissible and has VC dimension two. No projection to at most one coordinate has four shattered subsets, while the full projection has five; hence every admissible projection has VC dimension at least two and $\mathrm{SCVC}(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{int}})=2$.
